SELECT TOP 10 * FROM 
        (SELECT A.ACID, A.TRAN_DATE_BAL, A.EOD_DATE, A.END_EOD_DATE
        ,B.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, ISNULL(VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, 1.00)*(A.TRAN_DATE_BAL) AS RelExp_BUSC
        ,B.ACID AS ACID_GAM, B.FORACID FROM busc.LNS_EODACCTBAL A
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE isLatest = 1 and isActive = 1) B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE WHERE isLatest = 1 AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND RATECODE = 'REV' AND RTLIST_DATE = '2023-01-27') C ON C.FXD_CRNCY_CODE = B.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AND C.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
        WHERE A.EOD_DATE <= '2023-01-27' AND A.END_EOD_DATE >= '2023-01-27') BUSC
    FULL OUTER JOIN
        (SELECT DISTINCT A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodStartDate, A.BalanceAmount
        ,B.IsoCurrencyCode, ISNULL(C.ConversionRate, 1.00)*A.BalanceAmount AS RelExp_BNKM
        FROM (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND PeriodStartDate <= '2023-01-27' AND PeriodEndDate >= '2023-01-27' AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS') A
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS') B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' AND CurrencyConversionTimestamp = '2023-01-27') C ON C.ConvertFromCurrencyId = B.IsoCurrencyCode AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
        ) BNKM 
            ON BUSC.FORACID = BNKM.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE (BUSC.ACID IS NOT NULL AND BUSC.FORACID IS NULL)
    (BNKM.CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL AND BUSC.ACID IS NULL)
    (BNKM.CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL AND BUSC.ACID IS NOT NULL) 
    AND BUSC.TRAN_DATE_BAL != BNKM.BalanceAmount



SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 
        (SELECT A.ACID, A.TRAN_DATE_BAL, A.EOD_DATE, A.END_EOD_DATE
        ,B.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, ISNULL(VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, 1.00)*(A.TRAN_DATE_BAL) AS RelExp_BUSC
        ,B.ACID AS ACID_GAM, B.FORACID FROM busc.LNS_EODACCTBAL A
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE isLatest = 1 and isActive = 1) B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE WHERE isLatest = 1 AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND RATECODE = 'REV' AND RTLIST_DATE = '2023-01-27') C ON C.FXD_CRNCY_CODE = B.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AND C.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
        WHERE A.EOD_DATE <= '2023-01-27' AND A.END_EOD_DATE >= '2023-01-27') BUSC
    FULL OUTER JOIN
        (SELECT DISTINCT A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodStartDate, A.BalanceAmount
        ,B.IsoCurrencyCode, ISNULL(C.ConversionRate, 1.00)*A.BalanceAmount AS RelExp_BNKM
        FROM (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND PeriodStartDate <= '2023-01-27' AND PeriodEndDate >= '2023-01-27' AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS') A
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS') B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' AND CurrencyConversionTimestamp = '2023-01-27') C ON C.ConvertFromCurrencyId = B.IsoCurrencyCode AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
        ) BNKM 
            ON BUSC.FORACID = BNKM.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE (BUSC.ACID IS NOT NULL AND BNKM.CustomerAccountId IS NULL)
    (BNKM.CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL AND BUSC.ACID IS NULL)
    (BNKM.CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL AND BUSC.ACID IS NOT NULL) 
    (BUSC.ACID IS NOT NULL AND BUSC.FORACID IS NULL)
    AND BUSC.TRAN_DATE_BAL != BNKM.BalanceAmount
